breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradiction by requesting both a "gamma-centered" k-point grid and a "half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh". The ground truth correctly resolved this by removing the conflicting "half shift" instruction. The generated specification failed to fix this error and instead included both contradictory instructions, stating: "use a gamma-centered ... Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with automatic sampling and half shift". A gamma-centered grid cannot also have a half shift.
